correctness.rationale: Independently verified the certificate with degree-set arithmetic and direct polynomial remainders of t^j r, not the supplied shift recurrence. P=f^3 divides t^28+1, so reduction is a surjective intertwiner, and the four independent quotient rows pull back to the four stated length-28 rows and preserve codimension four. All 22 least representatives, orbit lengths and first kernel witnesses matched; the size histogram is {1:1,7:1,14:4,28:16} and exhausts 512 states. Each quotient orbit hits K, so a shift of each original vector lies in the preimage U. The union bound for 28 shifts gives 2^c<=28<32, establishing sharpness.

evidence: Wang–Shi Theorem 5 gives h_2(2p)=2 under odd-prime and primitive-root restrictions. Li–Yuan–Li–Zeng attribute h_2(21)=4 to Sun–Ma–Zeng. The latter paper's abstract says it solves some special lengths without specifying length 28 in the material accessed.
